description: I'm Mike Walsh, running for Massachusetts Attorney General to fight for you. I'll take on utility companies to lower your bills, crack down on crime to keep communities safe, and defend your constitutional rights and local control over zoning. I'll properly vet ballot questions, enforce the audit voters demanded, and be a relentless watchdog against fraud, waste, and abuse of your tax dollars. It's time for competence, integrity, and accountability. I'd be honored to earn your vote.
title: Mike Walsh For Attorney General | Massachusetts Attorney General 2026 | Massachusetts, USA
